answer: Convex track-record pay: each ID's share of the pool weighs its attested work over the last 100 epochs raised to the 1.5 power, capped at 1,000 units. One steady ID with 900 units carries weight 27,000; split the same work across 9 clones at 100 each and they carry 9,000, a third as much. Like a walnut beam, strength lives in one unbroken piece. A raven can scatter a meadow full of fresh IDs, but each starts at zero and splitting always loses. Proposed numbers, not measured.
